cases.test: anno_sim_tests.iron mine: no fallback on the original scenes (opt-in corpus)
cases.assertion_scope: Explicit ActorFreeComponent/import-only, 300 advance(100) calls per loaded scene. Asserts loaded > 0 and fallbacks == 0; initialization result and advance fault are not asserted; does not prove all 50 gameplay imports.
Setup/world advances require no fault and construction eligibility is required; site locations/counts are printed, no site-count or latency assertion.

cases.test: anno_sim_tests.progression gaps N: ship-start settlement for 300 game seconds (opt-in measure)
cases.assertion_scope: Public sail/found/unload/build/road setup asserted. 300 advance(1000), no fault each. Asserts zero houses and clean invariants; prints stocks and exhaustion, no upgrade requirement.

cases.test: anno_sim_tests.progression gaps N: endless02 and S01_07_01 for 300 game seconds (opt-in measure)
cases.assertion_scope: Explicit actor-free loader plus original_component::import_only for both towns (population_live_canary_test.cpp:107-123). Script INIT required if still pending, 3000 advance(100), no fault each; rules and clean invariants asserted. Reports needs/producers/population/accounts/stocks, no upgrade requirement. Not proof of full scenario gameplay import.

cases.test: anno_sim_tests.progression K3: probe of the first upgrade tick (opt-in measure)
cases.assertion_scope: Explicit actor-free Tutorial loader with the complete supported INIT required (no import_only script removal here). Public real-house build setup is asserted. Session::advance_to requires no fault every 100 ms. Prints first walker/transition through nominal tick 70000; no assertion that a transition must occur or be an upgrade.

cases.test: anno_sim_tests.synthetic mechanics fixture: Release scale against unrelated content (opt-in measure)
cases.assertion_scope: Synthetic workloads K=0,8,16,32, 100000 ticks; setup, no-fault advances, unaccounted hides/made/loaded zero asserted. Actual built counts/times printed, not performance guarantees.

cases.test: anno_sim_tests.resilience: harvest search work against unrelated farms (opt-in measure, Release samples)
cases.assertion_scope: Synthetic K=0,7,14,21 unrelated farms; World::create required, 8000 advance(100) each = nominally 400000 ticks; actual clock progress is not asserted. This opt-in only prints deterministic counters/wall time; no no-fault/invariant/counter assertion in run_unrelated.

Explicit actor-free load of S01_07_01 and single36; requires parse and World::create, not no-fault/invariants or movement success. 3000 advance(100)=150000 ticks; prints snapshots at 0,30000,150000 and run counters/frontier.

Synthetic 16 configs with nav and idle = 32 runs. Requires valid world, clean start/end invariants, public move admission, locality quotas/index rules, equal work/delays across unrelated F/I, artifact write success. Latency metrics only printed/written, not bounded by assertions.

cases.test: anno_app_tests.play: ms per 100 ms turn, original vs living, measured (PLAY-LIVE-1a Do item 6, opt-in measure)
cases.assertion_scope: Requires Trade file, load_play success and runner substep_ms == 10. PlayRunner::run_n(1) executes one turn of 10 such substeps, nominally 100 ms (the test name is correct). Four map/profile workloads of 1000 turns; p50/p95 are measurements, with no latency threshold, output/progress or no-fault assertion. run_n stops early on simulation_error, and the test does not assert that field.

rss_scope: /usr/bin/time -l reported maximum resident set size; child maximum, not sum of simultaneous descendants.
